firstPlayerRule: There is no fixed first player. During setup the group chooses a lead investigator, and each investigation phase the investigators decide together who takes the first turn.
clarifications: The lead investigator holds the lead investigator token, breaks ties and makes decisions for the group if there is a conflict.
In the investigation phase, the group chooses who goes first. After each turn, they choose who goes next, until every investigator has had a turn.
When the rules say “in player order”, the lead investigator goes first, then the others clockwise.
In the first round, skip the mythos phase and begin with the investigation phase.
